Phase 53 implementation @ 29c3ac4 (branch phase/legacy-diagnostics), per approved plan r2.
What/where:
- tagteam/diagnostics.py (new): read_bounded (lstat root-down, regular files only, O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, 256KB Markdown truncated / 64KB JSON skipped); legacy scan (retired-command, fixed-role judged against each role's identities = name + launch basename/provider + headless provider, legacy-skill-shape; one finding per rule+line; Phase 52 managed paths excluded via framework.build_plan; user-level Phase 49 candidates by path only); roles with separate desktop/headless observations (no args emitted; NAME=value or unsplittable -> unknown); plugin_availability from list_plugins (unknown vs missing/disabled/broken/found; plugin_status untouched); instruction sources + headless injection/truncation via headless.select_context_file; .mcp.json server names, Claude settings hook events/matchers, .codex/config.toml presence; protection notes; text + --json (schema 1).
- tagteam/cli.py: doctor subcommand, help, READ_ONLY_COMMANDS + summary. tagteam/setup.py: report_legacy_workflow pointer after the framework report (so upgrade prints it per project); scan failure prints a note, exit codes unchanged.
- tagteam/data/workflows.md: Diagnostics + Capabilities and alternatives sections (stale 'safe migration is separate work' line replaced). README command list. Plan implementation notes + roadmap.
Deviations worth checking (in the plan's Implementation notes): roles described whenever both names exist (so an explicit unknown headless.provider shows as unknown rather than dropping the section); this repo's docs/workflows.md is custom under Phase 52 and was not refreshed.
Verification: tests/test_diagnostics.py 47 tests (Northstar-shaped fixtures both assignments, non-findings, managed exclusion, symlink/dir/oversize, user-level never read, executables, AGENTS/CLAUDE matrix x both assignments, truncation, unknown/explicit-unknown provider, Architect desktop-claude/headless-codex modes, name/command inference, sentinels in launch args/NAME= prefix/headless.args/.mcp env+headers+args, symlinked config to home secret, symlinked .claude parent, dir/FIFO/oversize/malformed/wrong-type, hook scope note, plugin missing-CLI/timeout/malformed/non-zero/absent/disabled/broken/found vs plugin_status, exit codes, JSON counts, TAGTEAM_READ_ONLY cli.main + tree/home mtime snapshot, setup/upgrade preview tree unchanged, pointer present/absent/per-project/failure). Focused neighbours pass (readonly, plugin, setup, framework, onboarding, quickstart, state_sync: 451 passed). Manual: doctor on this repo (0 findings, tree unchanged) and Northstar (6 info). Full suite: gate: see entry @ 29c3ac4. Not verified on Windows/Linux.

GATE: PASS | scope 6 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (1888 passed, 5 skipped, 5m17s)
checked: HEAD 29c3ac4

Reviewed implementation 29c3ac4 against approved plan r2. Gate PASS accepted: 1888 passed, 5 skipped at 29c3ac4. Reviewer focused run: tests/test_diagnostics.py, 47 passed in 2.84s; no full-suite rerun. Two additional temporary-project reproductions expose gaps in the promised input/output boundaries:

1. [P1] tagteam.yaml bypasses the bounded, shape-checked reader (tagteam/diagnostics.py:600 and :609). Both legacy_findings and build_report call config.read_config directly; that helper follows symlinks and uses unbounded Path.read_text. Reproduction: symlink project/tagteam.yaml to an outside YAML containing lead name SENTINEL_OUTSIDE; build_report reads it and emits that name. Replace the link with a FIFO: doctor blocks; the isolated subprocess had to be killed at a 2-second timeout. This contradicts the approved all-files reader policy and the shipped claim that symlinks/non-regular files are never followed or opened. Read and parse the role config through the safe bounded path, emit a clear unsupported/skipped/unknown note as appropriate, and continue producing the report. Cover symlink, FIFO, oversized and malformed role config in doctor and the legacy-summary path. Ensure the parser does not reopen the original path after validating it.

2. [P1] Legacy evidence emits command arguments and secrets (tagteam/diagnostics.py:456 onward, scan_file). excerpt is the first 120 characters of the entire matching line. Reproduction: AGENTS.md contains 'Use /handoff-plan --api-key SENTINEL_ARG for planning.' Both the text report and JSON contain SENTINEL_ARG. The same leak occurs when a token shares a line with a fixed-role statement. The plan and shipped docs promise no command arguments or secret configuration values in output; stripping args from tagteam.yaml alone does not meet that guarantee. Construct evidence from the recognized match/token or another explicitly bounded safe representation, retaining path/line and useful remediation while excluding surrounding argument/value text. Add sentinel tests for retired-command and fixed-role lines in both output formats.

No interjections were present. The separate mode reporting, unknown plugin status handling, setup/upgrade integration and existing focused fixtures otherwise align with the revised plan. Preserving this repo's customized docs/workflows.md through the Phase 52 policy is justified.

Round 2 @ 1d3a35f — both P1 findings fixed (plan doc: 'Round 2 (impl review)').
1. tagteam.yaml: new diagnostics.read_role_config reads through read_bounded (lstat root-down, regular file, O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, 64KB not truncated) and parses those bytes with config's YAML/fallback parser — the path is never reopened. build_report and legacy_findings both use it. Symlink/FIFO/dir/oversize/malformed/non-mapping -> 'tagteam.yaml not read: …' note (first in notes, shown under Roles), report continues without roles, legacy scan still runs. Tests (TestRoleConfigRead): symlink to outside SENTINEL_OUTSIDE (absent from text+JSON), oversize, malformed, list YAML, each in build_report and legacy_findings with config.read_config and framework.read_config patched to raise; FIFO via subprocesses (doctor_command, legacy_findings, python -m tagteam doctor) with timeout 30 -> exit 0, note printed. Not changed: setup.main's own pre-existing read_config for validation warnings.
2. Evidence: excerpt is the regex match only (retired-command group(0) per match, fixed-role match text); each retired-command occurrence is its own finding. test_evidence_is_the_match_not_the_line: SENTINEL values after /handoff-plan, after 'Codex is the lead', after ai_handoff, and in a skill line with 'Claude (Lead)' + /handoff-cycle -> exact excerpts asserted, no SENTINEL in text or JSON.
Verification: tests/test_diagnostics.py 53 passed; readonly/plugin/setup/framework 340 passed. Full suite: gate: see entry @ 1d3a35f.

GATE: PASS | scope 6 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (1894 passed, 5 skipped, 5m18s)
checked: HEAD 1d3a35f

Approved implementation at 1d3a35f. Both round-1 P1 findings are resolved: build_report and legacy_findings parse tagteam.yaml from the bounded, shape-checked read without reopening its path; unsupported/oversized/malformed role config is handled without blocking doctor. Legacy evidence now contains the recognized match rather than surrounding argument/value text. Reviewed the revision diff and regression tests covering symlinked and FIFO role config, oversized/malformed config, and sentinel values adjacent to both finding rules in text and JSON.

Verification: accepted GATE PASS at matching HEAD 1d3a35f (1894 passed, 5 skipped; scope and plan-doc pass). Reviewer focused run: tests/test_diagnostics.py, 53 passed in 3.34s. No full-suite rerun. No interjections present. No blocking findings remain from this review. The pre-existing setup validation reader is unchanged and outside these diagnostics fixes; this approval does not claim that all existing setup readers gained the new safeguards.
